claims.quote: what we are finding is we are not far from the world—I think we'll be there in three to six months—where AI is writing 90 percent of the code.
claims.claim: AI will be writing 90% of all code within three to six months of March 2025.
claims.resolutionCriteria: By September 2025, about 90% of newly written code across the software industry is generated by AI.

source.title: CEO Speaker Series with Dario Amodei, Council on Foreign Relations (transcript)

grading.rationale: Six months after the forecast, reporting cited earlier Microsoft and Google estimates of roughly 25-30% of their code being AI-generated, and an independent October 2025 analysis found that only a minority of Anthropic's own teams were near 90%. Amodei later said most code at Anthropic itself is AI-written; this grade uses the industry-wide reading of 'the code'.

evidence.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's prediction about AI in software development is nowhere nearly to becoming a reality
evidence.snippet: having passed the six-month mark, Amodei's bold prediction hasn't quite come to fruition

evidence.title: Is 90% of code at Anthropic being written by AIs?
evidence.snippet: There exist some teams at Anthropic where around 90% of lines of code that get merged are written by AI, but this is a minority of teams.

claims.quote: I predicted that AI could displace half of all entry-level white collar jobs in the next 1–5 years, even as it accelerates economic growth and scientific progress.
claims.claim: AI will displace half of all entry-level white-collar jobs within one to five years of Amodei's 2025 warning.
claims.resolutionCriteria: By May 2030, credible labor data show roughly half of entry-level white-collar jobs displaced by AI.

claims.quote: We believe that, in 2025, we may see the first AI agents "join the workforce" and materially change the output of companies.
claims.claim: In 2025, the first AI agents will join the workforce and materially change the output of companies.
claims.resolutionCriteria: During 2025, AI agents are deployed as working contributors inside companies and measurably change company output, as shown by independent adoption and productivity data.

grading.rationale: AI agents entered production at some firms in 2025 (McKinsey found 23% of respondents' organizations scaling an agentic system), but year-end reviews found that interest had not translated into broad deployment or a material change in most companies' output.

evidence.title: The state of AI in 2025: Agents, innovation, and transformation (McKinsey, November 2025)
evidence.snippet: Twenty-three percent of respondents report their organizations are scaling an agentic AI system somewhere in their enterprises

evidence.title: 2025 was set to be the year of AI agents. It was not.
evidence.snippet: that curiosity hasn't yet translated into broad deployment

claims.quote: change of plans: we are going to release o3 and o4-mini after all, probably in a couple of weeks, and then do GPT-5 in a few months
claims.claim: OpenAI will release GPT-5 within a few months of April 2025.
claims.resolutionCriteria: OpenAI publicly releases a model named GPT-5 within about six months of April 4, 2025.

grading.rationale: OpenAI released GPT-5 to ChatGPT users and the API on August 7, 2025, about four months after the post.

evidence.title: ChatGPT unlocks its next level with OpenAI's major GPT-5 update
evidence.snippet: OpenAI's long-awaited GPT-5 — a major update to the technology underlying ChatGPT — is a faster, more-capable large language model

evidence.title: OpenAI's GPT-5 Debuts with Commoditizing Costs and Higher Scrutiny
evidence.snippet: On August 7, 2025, the company rolled out GPT-5 to ChatGPT users and to the API

claims.quote: If I gave an AI… every single test that you can possibly imagine, you make that list of tests and put it in front of the computer science industry, and I'm guessing in five years time, we'll do well on every single one.
claims.claim: Within five years of March 2024, AI will do well on every test that can be devised to compare it with humans, Huang's test-based definition of AGI.
claims.resolutionCriteria: By March 2029, AI systems perform well on essentially every test devised to compare AI with human abilities, including professional, academic and reasoning exams.

source.title: Stanford SIEPR Economic Summit (quoted by Fox Business)

claims.quote: From ChatGPT to o1 to Astra in 4 years. AGI has arrived. Congratulations @OpenAI team.
claims.claim: Artificial general intelligence has arrived, marked by OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra model.
claims.resolutionCriteria: An agreed definition or widely accepted test of AGI is met by OpenAI's Astra, as judged by independent researchers.

grading.rationale: There is no universally accepted definition or test for AGI, so the statement cannot be checked against an agreed standard; critics including Gary Marcus said it was made with no evidence and no definitions.

evidence.title: Jensen Huang Says 'AGI Has Arrived' With OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, but Has It Really?
evidence.snippet: Sad to see Jensen claim that AGI has arrived, with no evidence and no definitions.

evidence.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang says 'We've achieved AGI.' But no one can agree on what that means.
evidence.snippet: That's been the case even though there is no universally accepted definition of the term.

claims.quote: Probably in 2025, we at Meta as well as the other companies that are basically working on this are going to have an AI that can effectively be a sort of mid-level engineer that you have at your company that can write code.
claims.claim: In 2025, Meta and other AI companies will have an AI that can effectively work as a mid-level software engineer writing code.
claims.resolutionCriteria: By the end of 2025, Meta or another company has an AI system that does the coding work of a mid-level software engineer with comparable autonomy and reliability.

source.title: Joe Rogan Experience #2255 - Mark Zuckerberg (quoted by Windows Central)

grading.rationale: AI coding tools were widely used by the end of 2025, but the best model METR had measured completed software tasks that take humans about five hours only half the time, short of working as a mid-level engineer. In July 2026 Zuckerberg told staff that agent development had not accelerated as Meta expected.

evidence.title: METR on X: Claude Opus 4.5 time horizon
evidence.snippet: We estimate that, on our tasks, Claude Opus 4.5 has a 50%-time horizon of around 4 hrs 49 mins (95% confidence interval of 1 hr 49 mins to 20 hrs 25 mins).

evidence.title: Exclusive-Zuckerberg says AI agent tech is developing more slowly than expected (Reuters)
evidence.snippet: I think the kind of trajectory of the agentic development over at least the last four months hasn't really accelerated in the way that we expected

claims.quote: In 2025, I expect Meta AI will be the leading assistant serving more than 1 billion people
claims.claim: In 2025, Meta AI will be the leading AI assistant, serving more than 1 billion people.
claims.resolutionCriteria: By the end of 2025, Meta AI serves more than 1 billion people and is the most-used AI assistant.

source.title: Mark Zuckerberg Facebook post (quoted by NBC News)

grading.rationale: Meta reported in May 2025 that Meta AI had one billion monthly active users across its apps, meeting the user target by its own count. Whether it was the leading assistant depends on the metric, as OpenAI reported 800 million weekly active users for ChatGPT in October 2025.

evidence.title: Meta AI now has 1B monthly active users
evidence.snippet: Meta AI now has one billion monthly active users across its apps

evidence.title: Sam Altman says ChatGPT has hit 800M weekly active users
evidence.snippet: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said Monday that ChatGPT has reached 800 million weekly active users

claims.quote: Our hope is that within the next decade, the metaverse will reach a billion people, host hundreds of billions of dollars of digital commerce, and support jobs for millions of creators and developers.
claims.claim: Within the next decade (by October 2031), the metaverse will reach a billion people.
claims.resolutionCriteria: By October 2031, immersive metaverse platforms (VR/AR virtual worlds) are used by about a billion people.

grading.rationale: The October 2031 deadline has not passed. Signals so far are weak: Reality Labs lost $19.2 billion in 2025, and in March 2026 Meta announced it would end VR access to Horizon Worlds, then reversed that decision days later.

evidence.title: Meta Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results
evidence.snippet: Segment table: Reality Labs loss from operations, full year 2025: $(19,193) million

evidence.title: Meta will shut down VR Horizon Worlds access in June
evidence.snippet: Horizon Worlds, Meta's first pass at a metaverse, will be inaccessible via virtual reality headset after June 15, 2026.

evidence.title: Meta decides not to shut down Horizon Worlds on VR after all
evidence.snippet: We have decided, just today in fact, that we will keep Horizon Worlds working in VR

claims.quote: It's just completely obvious that within five years deep learning is going to do better than radiologists.… It might be 10 years, but we've got plenty of radiologists already.
claims.claim: Within five years of October 2016, deep learning will do better than human radiologists, so training new radiologists should stop.
claims.resolutionCriteria: By October 2021, deep learning outperforms human radiologists at their core work, making the training of new radiologists unnecessary.

source.title: Machine Learning and the Market for Intelligence, Creative Destruction Lab, Toronto (quoted by The New Republic)

grading.rationale: AI did not surpass radiologists at their overall work by 2021, and demand for radiologists kept growing: U.S. active radiologists rose about 10% over the decade and Mayo Clinic's radiologist numbers rose 55% since 2016. As of May 2026, near the 10-year outer bound Hinton also mentioned, radiologists remained in short supply.

evidence.title: A decade after the 'Godfather of AI' said radiologists were obsolete, their salaries are up to $571K and demand is growing fast
evidence.snippet: Over the last 10 years, the number of active radiologists in the U.S. has grown by about 10%

evidence.title: AI and the Radiologist Apocalypse That Wasn't
evidence.snippet: At the Mayo Clinic, where radiologist numbers have jumped 55 percent since then
